name: Guna

queries.query: Guna Madhya Pradesh official cadastral map land records bhu naksha Guna
queries.result: First-party discovery located the District Guna Government of Madhya Pradesh land-records page directing users to the MP land-records service, and the official Guna GIS page linking to the district GIS portal. No anonymous parcel feature service or downloadable parcel geometry was exposed in the indexed result.

queries.query: गुना मध्य प्रदेश भू नक्शा आधिकारिक खसरा नक्शा
queries.result: First-party discovery located the Hindi District Guna land-records page, which directs users to landrecords.mp.gov.in. This confirms a public land-records/map service in the state workflow but provides no safe parcel ID/geometry response for Guna.

researchNotes: Official district pages evidence the local custodian/service pathway, but the bounded anonymous API/UI follow-up did not yield parcel records. A timeout is not treated as citywide absence. No sample GeoJSON is retained.
